reviewItem.question: Does "Flux controllers upgrade: The Flux controllers have the capability to upgrade themselves if they were installed using the bootstrap procedure" mean a change to migration:flux|name=controllers-upgrade (migration-required)?

proposed.statement: For environments where Flux was installed using the bootstrap procedure, upgrading the Flux controllers to this release is an operator step: generate the new Kubernetes manifests with the Flux CLI and push them to the Git repository where bootstrap was run (including any extra components enabled at bootstrap), or rerun the bootstrap command for each cluster using the same arguments as before.
